title: Manage semantic review lifecycle deterministically
summary: Approved semantic stacks can be published, prepared locally as one branch or a stack, landed externally, and archived without ad hoc Git surgery.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The validated active artifact can be committed as a metadata-only commit through a script.
A script validates the stage branch chain and emits hosting-neutral local preparation data only when the stack and metadata are valid.
A merged published review can be moved to stable history and committed, leaving no active artifact.
